Local news and positive stories from Duluth, Minnesota.  Our YouTube channel primarily focuses on positive content, from uplifting stories, to the latest trends in what's brewing (beer & coffee), to fun explanations of what causes weather conditions.  Make sure to check out our playlists for The Lift and Weatherz School!

Subscribe and stay connected with us on social:
